sentences.text: This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
ORDER 1.

This is a repeat bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.
on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 19.12.2020 in connection with Crime No.585/2020,
registered at Police Station Cantt. District Sagar for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467,
468, 471, 406, 193 of the IPC.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 19.12.2020.
Trial is likely to take long time.
Number of witnesses are yet to be examined.

In these circumstances,
applicant who is under trial prisoner may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that applicant had committed cheating with many persons.
He is hardcore criminal.

sentences.text: Earlier bail applications of applicant have been dismissed on merits and there is no change circumstances.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5 .

Considering the fact that applicant is in jail since 19.12.2020 and trial is likely to take some time,
bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.
